item.title: Will Mass. get snow on Sunday? Depends on track of intense storm developing offshore
item.description: In Boston, the chance of getting 6 inches of snow or more is currently around 30%. But a shift of even 10 to 20 miles in the storm’s path could spell the difference between meaningful snow or little, if anything.

item.title: ‘Could happen anywhere’: Mayors gather in D.C. to discuss immigration enforcement in their cities
item.description: As the Trump administration comes under pressure to de-escalate the immigration crackdown in the Twin Cities, mayors of both parties sounded alarms.

item.title: The promise and reality of the rural health fund
item.description: In the 2025 budget bill, Congress created the $50 billion Rural Health Transformation Program to help struggling hospitals, doctors, and patients in rural America. But rural hospitals are expected to lose three times that through Medicaid cuts in that same budget bill. So, what will it take to keep rural healthcare afloat?

item.title: Maine leaders react cautiously to end of ICE crackdown
